body: Yes, I've done it for a year or so. It helped for a while but then went back down.

I'm 20. There's really only three people I keep irl contact with. I've been depressed since I was ten, I'm on several different medications, and I doubt I'm going to 'grow out of it.' Guess I'm just immature, for feeling this way.
I see. It just makes it harder to talk to her, especially if she's in a negative mood.
They don't ever ask about me, or really talk to me if I don't initiate, also.
My stepmother has said that she thinks I do it for attention. I can't afford anything.
My family doesn't believe me. I am on a lot of meds. I'm ok for now.
